area: Countywide developed parcels (roll does not identify city vs unincorporated; FAQ does not limit it to unincorporated)
name: Stormwater utility fee - residential (levy code STWR)
how_charged: Flat $40 per developed residential parcel; each condominium unit is a separate residential property; DOR land use 1,2,4,5,50. Exempt: qualified senior, disabled veteran and disabled-person homesteads, community cemeteries.
fiscal_year: FY2025-26 (2025 roll); rate in place since 2006 roll

name: Stormwater utility fee - commercial (levy code STWC)
MSTU - Fire Services (ad valorem, NOT a non-ad valorem assessment)
how_charged: Ad valorem millage on taxable value: 1.3800 mills for FY2026. Listed here because unincorporated fire is funded by millage, not a per-unit assessment; no county fire NAV appears on the 2025 NAV roll.

name: Street lighting assessments (levy codes ALSL1 and BOCA)
how_charged: Flat per parcel within each lighting unit (ALSL1 $60.00 x 43 parcels; BOCA $27.00 x 33 parcels). DOR county total for Lighting = $3,471. Unit names not decoded from public listing.

government: Bay County (Board of County Commissioners) - per DOR classification
name: Levy code PPCD (DOR function: community development/redevelopment)
how_charged: Parcel-specific amounts ($1,003.38 to $199,609.02); total $1,013,419.22. Code likely refers to the Pier Park Community Development District (Panama City Beach) - NOT confirmed; DOR files it under the county.

name: Liens / other (levy codes LIEN, PCN)
how_charged: Parcel-specific; LIEN 241 parcels $312,691.90; PCN 17 parcels $22,155.28. DOR county 'Other' total $334,847.

name: Fire service assessment (levy code PCF)
how_charged: By property type: homesteaded residential dwelling unit $150 (maximum); non-homestead residential (e.g., rentals) $300 per unit; vacant land $24.51 per parcel (FY2024-25 figure, matches 2025 roll); commercial/non-residential by building square footage and fire-response factors (per-sq-ft rates not found).
rate: $150 homestead unit / $300 non-homestead unit / $24.51 vacant parcel

name: Fire service assessment (levy code PBF)
how_charged: Two tiers: Tier 1 per $1,000 of improvement value (Property Appraiser) + Tier 2 flat per tax parcel. Noticed MAXIMUM FY2025-26 rates: $0.78 per $1,000 improvement value + $95.66 per parcel (4% over FY2024-25).

name: Stormwater management assessment (levy code PBSW)
how_charged: Tier 1 per $1,000 improvement value + Tier 2 per parcel. Noticed MAXIMUM FY2025-26: $0.49 per $1,000 improvement value + $48.30 per parcel.

area: Front Beach Road Community Redevelopment Area only
name: Front Beach Road CRA assessment (levy code PBCRA)
how_charged: Category A $38.95 per parcel flat; Category B weighted: $0.009 per heated/AC sq ft (60%), $0.04 per $1,000 improvement value (30%), $0.06 per $1,000 land value (10%). Noticed maximum FY2025-26.
rate: $38.95 per parcel (Category A) or weighted by building size and value (Category B)

name: Stormwater assessment (levy code LN)
how_charged: Per equivalent billing unit (1 unit = 3,900 sq ft impervious area); vacant land 0.28 units. Adopted Aug 2021 at about $139 per unit. FY2025-26 per-unit rate not found; FY2026 budget carries $2,652,000 non-ad valorem stormwater revenue.
rate: about $139 per unit (2021 adoption); current per-unit rate not located

name: Fire assessment (levy code SF)
how_charged: Not documented in a located resolution. 2025 roll: most common bill $146.57 (721 parcels); median $207.40; amounts vary by parcel.
